sharedProducerRules.status: Set membership and exact prefix partition the status grammar; target precedes terminal/human and detail, then skipped/completed fallback. Each literal and prefix boundary is executed, not merely reasoned equivalent.
sharedProducerRules.detail: outcomeOfExit emits needs-human: text only on nonzero/null non-signal non-error exits. Error uses spawn failed:, signal killed by, completion exit 0; runPlannedCard interruption replaces detail. The detail row crosses every status rule.
sharedProducerRules.reachability: Default in-process runner returns zero/nonzero with captured statuses; the injected CardProcessRunner seam also accepts signals/errors. Built-in spawn errors never carry status; status+error tests are conservative typed-boundary controls/witnesses, not claims a failed spawn emitted a status. Signal after emitted status is accepted by spawnCardProcess. No real child/engine is run.
sharedProducerRules.interruption: Spy only isInterrupted (external event detector) after the stubbed card returns. Production runPlannedCard creates interrupted; cardRunner restores status; production classify/list/report run. No real SIGINT is sent: real whileInterruptible exits the process and never settles for audit. These rows prove result classification, not OS cleanup.
sharedProducerRules.preparation: Absent-status completed cases have prepare undefined and no durable target. They pin existing no-cycle/no-op fallback only. Successful unfinished preparation and durable lifecycle progress remain r0-2 in r1-g2; no guard here claims that preparation reached target.

transitionMatrix.source: Pending id in runCardList; durable closed state checked before invoking card; outcome produced by per-card lifecycle
transitionMatrix.event: CardProcessExit for invoked id carrying gate-red; completed/failed/crashed(signal or error)/interrupted representation preserved by cardRunner
transitionMatrix.predecessor: The actual per-card result; no synthetic terminal event or handoff accepted by this classifier
transitionMatrix.next: CardResult terminal; remove from pending; preserve reason and original id/order; append final list audit; exit 1
transitionMatrix.forbidden: terminal -> retryable within same invocation despite peer progress (W1,W2); terminal -> at-target from exit 0 alone (C1); terminal status misreported at cap (W5)
transitionMatrix.retryReplayRestart: W1/W2 and I1-gate-* prohibit replay inside an invocation; R1 executes terminal gate-red then a second open invocation in the same process/root and verifies a fresh closedAt read plus renewed run; R2 executes terminal gate-red then a closed invocation and verifies the new closedAt read and skip. C6 remains a first-invocation closed control. No persisted event identity or stale writer exists here.
transitionMatrix.terminalPreconditions: Explicit gate-red status survives all accepted result forms; child-only crash does not stop peers; a global interrupted detector prevents new peer starts. Terminal marker does not constitute at-target. Failed-* and human controls retain behavior.
transitionMatrix.immutable: Card id, original order, gate reason remain unchanged
transitionMatrix.metrics: Pass count and final list audit reflect real runs (W1,W2); no cycle budget or ledger modified
transitionMatrix.negativeFamiliesNotApplicable: N1 excludes persisted workflow families only; N2 excludes impossible conversion combinations. Restart is mandatory and proved by R1/R2.
